name: Gasthof Neuhaus
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Gasthof Neuhaus in Kufstein, Tirol, is a traditional inn with a regional character. The location of the Gasthof Neuhaus is situated in the town of Kufstein, offering a view of the surrounding mountain world. The atmosphere is shaped by Tiroler hospitality and a down-to-earth ambiance. Guests can expect regionale Küche as well as simply and cozily furnished rooms. The surroundings of the fortress town provide access to hiking trails and excursion destinations in the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The facilities include a guest garden and sufficient parking options for arriving guests.
